revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth ~16%, Q1'26 guided ~15% growth (Yahoo/Zacks on Q4'25); decelerating as base scales, driven by pricing, ads and membership.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: D&A history not found; Netflix PP&E D&A is small (~1% of revenue or less). Excludes content amortization (in operating costs, treated as cash-like).

wacc.source: Assumption: large-cap equity beta ~1.2, rf ~4.3%, ERP ~4.5-5%, minimal debt weight (~3%) -> ~9%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: slightly above long-run inflation/nominal GDP-ish, below WACC; mature global streamer.

net_debt.source: Approximate: gross debt $14.5B (Q3'25 shareholder letter; year-end figure not retrieved) minus cash & equivalents $9.03B at 12/31/2025 (Yahoo/Zacks on Q4'25). Short-term investments not found. Reviewer should update with 10-K balance sheet.
